# Quality Stress Fixture Roadmap

## Patch F — Accommodation Stress Fixtures

Goals:
- Preserve hotel name, city, nights, room quantities, bed type, and meal plan.
- Protect multi-room bookings and cabin-style accommodation rows.
- Avoid turning meal-plan or room-category fragments into hotel names.
- Keep day-page and inclusion-page accommodation wording aligned.

## Patch G — Activity and Compound Experience Fixtures

Protect Tallinn-style umbrella/detail rows, Norway in a Nutshell, Golden Circle, South Coast, multi-stop tours, and premium activity descriptions.

## Patch H — Optional, Commercial Status, and Flights

Protect optional-state safety, self-arranged flights, included/excluded flights, luggage details, paid-locally rows, and mixed included/not-included rows.

## Patch I — Leisure, Arrival, Departure, and Metadata Cleanup

Protect leisure rows from becoming fake activities, improve arrival/departure titles, and prevent raw metadata leakage.
